title: Lease terms and ownership context
summary: This topic centers on lease situations and related ownership context, with one clear complaint about wanting to exit a lease and several fragments that mention leasing arrangements without clear evaluative sentiment.

negative.summary: The negative feedback is a direct complaint about dissatisfaction with the vehicle severe enough that the reviewer wanted to pay to get out of the lease.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mention leasing, negotiation, charger-use assumptions, and other owned vehicles, but they do not clearly express a positive, negative, or neutral evaluation of the G70.

limitations: The sample is very small, and most fragments are undetermined rather than clearly evaluative.
This topic mixes lease dissatisfaction with non-evaluative references to lease negotiation, charger assumptions, and ownership context, so the examples do not form a single consistent issue.
Some fragments appear to reference other brands or broader ownership situations rather than a clearly stated assessment of the G70.
